verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe ran a real, keyless, end-to-end install headlessly: `npx -y skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development -a claude-code -y --copy` fetched the repo and placed a readable SKILL.md with no prompts (probe-rt-1). Superpowers also documents agent-driven install paths, such as telling Codex/OpenCode to fetch and follow a raw INSTALL.md (comm-5) and single-command installs like `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` and `/plugin install`. missing for 10: the headless probe relies on a third-party `skills` installer rather than a first-party Superpowers CLI; no first-party docs explicitly guarantee promptless, non-interactive installs across harnesses; the INSTALL.md agent path is evidenced only by a community report.
